name: Claimlume Faucet Rewards
author: Sipho Nhlapo

sections.description:
Claimlume Faucet Rewards provides a standalone rewards site using WordPress
accounts and administration without WooCommerce. New installations keep public
registration, reward, withdrawal, PTC and leaderboard features disabled until
configured. Pages are created as drafts for the administrator to review.

Free includes:
* Standalone landing, login, registration and member dashboard pages.
* Email verification, account profile and security controls.
* Fixed/random faucet rewards, cooldowns, daily claim limits and daily budget.
* Daily bonuses, streaks, one-level referrals, badges and XP.
* Timed sponsored visits with basic campaign management.
* Math, Cloudflare Turnstile, Google reCAPTCHA v2 and hCaptcha options.
* Exact eight-decimal USD wallet accounting and transaction history.
* Manual withdrawals and administrator-managed cryptocurrency rates.
* Basic leaderboard, notifications, editable content and email templates.
* Admin reports, tools, data repair controls and privacy callbacks.

Free vs Pro

Free is the core rewards application. Pro 1.0.0 adds shortlinks, offerwalls,
configurable referral levels, member bonuses, missions, scheduled announcements,
automatic CoinGecko rates, approved FaucetPay payout jobs, advanced PTC rules,
risk review signals and extended reports. Pro uses Free’s accounts and wallet.
Publisher accounts and provider configuration are required.

The comparison uses checkmarks for available features and dashes for unavailable
features. VPN/proxy detection, device fingerprinting, advertiser deposits,
withdrawal batching, retention analytics and email campaigns are not included.

External Services

Cloudflare Turnstile is optional and only contacted when the administrator
selects it. The browser loads its widget; the server sends the CAPTCHA token
and configured secret to Cloudflare for verification. Site hostname is checked.
Documentation: https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/
Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/
Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

Administrator-configured logos and banners load from their entered image URLs.
The image host receives ordinary browser request data such as IP address and user
agent when the image is displayed. Banner destinations and sponsored visits open
administrator-entered external URLs only on user action. Those destination sites
receive ordinary browser request data and apply their own terms and privacy policy.
The plugin does not make server-side requests to sponsor URLs. Site operators must
use only sponsor programs that expressly permit incentivized or rewarded traffic.
Email uses the website’s existing WordPress mail transport. Freemius handles the optional account connection and Pro licensing described below.

Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox is optional. When selected, the browser loads
Google’s widget and the server verifies the response token with the configured
secret. Tokens must pass the server response and hostname checks.
Documentation: https://developers.google.com/recaptcha/docs/verify
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

hCaptcha is optional. When selected, the browser loads the hCaptcha widget and
the server sends the token, site key and secret to hCaptcha for verification.
Documentation: https://docs.hcaptcha.com/
Terms: https://www.hcaptcha.com/terms
Privacy: https://www.hcaptcha.com/privacy

FaucetPay and CWallet are optional manual payout destination types. The plugin
does not contact either service. If enabled, a member provides an account email,
username or ID; the site operator then uses that identifier outside WordPress to
send payment manually. Operators should disclose this processing in their privacy
policy and review the services’ current terms and privacy notices.
FaucetPay: https://faucetpay.io/
FaucetPay terms: https://faucetpay.io/legal/terms
FaucetPay privacy: https://faucetpay.io/legal/privacy
CWallet: https://cwallet.com/

Cloudflare, Google, hCaptcha, FaucetPay and CWallet are trademarks of their
respective owners. Claimlume Faucet Rewards is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

Math verification binds to the member’s login session. For signed-out forms,
an essential HttpOnly browser cookie stores a random identifier for one day.
It does not contain an email, password or wallet address.

Freemius WordPress SDK 2.13.4 is bundled. Free is parent product 40542; Pro is
licensed add-on 40543. Free remains usable when the administrator skips the
optional Freemius connection. Pro requires entitlement from its SDK license or
trial. The configured trial is three days and requires payment details; eligibility,
prices, billing periods and site allowances are confirmed in Freemius checkout.

When an administrator connects, the SDK requests consent and explains the
administrator account, site and installation information it sends. Pro license
activation, validation and updates communicate with Freemius. License keys are
entered through SDK forms. Neither package includes a publisher private API key.
Service: https://freemius.com/
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Administration and appearance

All plugin admin pages use coordinated headers, cards, forms, tables and controls.
Notices appear outside the header banner. Standalone public and member pages
have compact layouts and system, light and dark theme choices.

Without Pro, the sidebar offers Upgrade (blue background) and Free vs Pro (green
background). Upgrade buttons open Pro checkout through the parent SDK, even
before Pro is installed; an optional official HTTPS sales page can be configured.
The catalog/download view is hidden. With Pro active, Upgrade and Free vs Pro
are hidden, old plans/catalog links open Pro, and Pro has a purple background.
The Pro license panel keeps license/account management without a plans button.

Updating

Back up the database and plugin files. Update Free before Pro. Replace each
existing plugin through WordPress upload; do not uninstall it to apply an update.
Pro requires Free 1.0.4 or newer to remain installed and active.

For original Vdot installations, deactivate the legacy copy before activating
Claimlume. Do not run both copies or use the legacy uninstaller, which can remove
shared data. Existing balances, history, settings and page IDs are reused;
[vdot_faucet] and [claimlume_faucet] shortcodes remain supported.

Verification

The release passed PHP 8.1/8.3 parsing and isolated integration checks covering
admin rendering, permissions, wallet accounting, shortlink/provider behavior,
licensing gates and dependency controls. These checks use WordPress/database
substitutes and do not constitute a complete hosted WordPress/MySQL test or a
WordPress Plugin Check approval. Test your database, mail, CAPTCHA and payment
workflows on staging before enabling public rewards.
sections.installation:
1. Use WordPress 7.1+, 64-bit PHP 8.1+ with OpenSSL, and MySQL/MariaDB InnoDB.
  2. Upload the Free ZIP under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and activate.
  3. You may skip the optional Freemius connection and continue using Free.
  4. Open Claimlume Faucet > Settings and Appearance & Content. Review and publish
    generated pages, edit legal content and configure your brand and mail templates.
  5. Verify mail delivery and configure the selected CAPTCHA provider.
  6. Enter currency rates before enabling manual withdrawals.
  7. Enable both WordPress registration and plugin registration only when ready.
  8. Test claims, sponsored visits, referrals and withdrawal completion/refunds.
  9. To add Pro, keep Free active, install Pro and activate its Freemius license.

No Composer, Node.js, Docker, WooCommerce or Laravel is required at runtime.
Generated vf- pages avoid overwriting existing site pages. Choose Faucet Home
under Settings > Reading if it should be the site’s homepage. There is no setup
wizard; configuration is performed manually in the admin pages.
sections.faq:
Does Free send cryptocurrency automatically?

No. Wallet, FaucetPay and CWallet are manual destination types in Free. The
administrator sends funds outside WordPress and records a transaction reference.
Pro can add configured approved-payout automation.

Why are currencies disabled initially?

Enter a current USD price per coin and enable the currency. No live rate is
invented. Quotes and exchange rates expire according to their configured rules.

How do I verify an account?

Use the verification email. Configure WordPress mail/SMTP if delivery fails.
Authorized administrators can resend verification under Members.

Does this stop every bot?

No. CAPTCHA, rate limits and reward limits assist abuse monitoring. Math CAPTCHA
is a basic testing option. Native WordPress login security is separate.

What happens when I uninstall?

Data is retained by default. Explicit removal settings can permanently remove
plugin records and generated pages. WordPress users are not deleted. Delete Pro
before deleting Free, even when both are inactive. Direct hosting-file deletion
cannot be prevented by a WordPress plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Add Free vs Pro comparison and SDK-backed Upgrade plans for administrators.
  • Integrate optional Freemius parent connection and Pro dependency protection.
  • Coordinate admin headers, cards, tables, forms and accessible controls.
  • Keep save/error notices outside admin banners.
  • Refine standalone public/member layouts and consistent theme selection.
  • Preserve accounts, wallet history and legacy shortcode/storage compatibility.
  • Correct Plugin Check translation, escaping, input handling and prepared queries.
  • Remove internal development notes from the installable package.
  • Store CAPTCHA setup/documentation navigation in bundled local metadata.
  • Keep this release at version 1.0.4.

1.0.3

  • Improve standalone pages, admin campaign/content management and wallet tools.
  • Correct reward writes, claim reconciliation and CAPTCHA configuration.

1.0.2

  • Improve faucet timing, missing-wallet recovery and historical claim repair.

1.0.1

  • Improve CAPTCHA, PTC campaign editing, admin navigation and schema repair.

1.0.0

  • Initial rewards, sponsored visits and manual withdrawal features.
